description: To celebrate the first ever Pimlico Open House Neighbourhood Festival, cave transforms its gallery space into a virtual map of Pimlico through it's exhibition, The Fabric of Pimlico. Celebrating the actors, authors and musicians who have made it their home over the year....no passport needed

factsheet.heading: History
paragraphs: Founded in 2014 at 81 Tachbrook Street, Cave Gallery & Studio has become a distinctive creative space in the heart of Pimlico. Conceived as more than a traditional gallery, Cave combines exhibition space, artist workshops, creative events and a curated shop selling art, vintage furniture and unique objects. Its aim has always been to create a place where local people can discover something new, meet artists and participate in creative activity.

Over the years, Cave has developed a reputation as a welcoming hub for independent artists and makers, hosting exhibitions, life drawing sessions, pottery workshops and community events. By bringing together artists, residents and visitors, it has helped foster a vibrant creative network in Pimlico while providing a platform for emerging talent.

Today, Cave Gallery & Studio continues to play an important role in the cultural life of the neighbourhood, offering a flexible space where art, creativity and community come together, reflecting the independent spirit that has long characterised Pimlico.
